task: Walk the work area with the homeowners and agree the site boundary
Set out the dust barriers, the floor protection and the crew entry route
Strip out the existing kitchen units and worktops
Remove the primary bath fittings and the floor tile
Clear the demolition waste from site and confirm the disposal run
Move the kitchen waste and supply lines to the new layout
Run the new kitchen and bath circuits back to the panel
Rough in the primary bath shower valve and the drain
Book and pass the rough in inspection
Take delivery of the cabinet run and check it against the selections sheet
Set and level the primary bath vanity and the mirror unit
Kitchen base and wall cabinet installation
Lay the kitchen and bath floor tile
Template, fit and seal the kitchen countertops
Hang the trim, the door casings and the shelving
Walk the punch list with the homeowners and log every item
Close out the punch list items raised at the walkthrough
Hand over the warranty pack, the care notes and the final drawings
